Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide __and wherein the compartment comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides__.

Claim 8 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 __wherein at least one of the plurality of different BMC polypeptides is from a different bacterial species__.

Claim 9 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 __wherein at least one of the plurality of different BMC polypeptides is from a different BMC operon__.

Claim 12 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide __to facilitate specific substrate conversion__.

Claim 21 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide __and capable of catalyzing a specific substrate conversion__ and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.
